videos.headline: Miami sacks Julian Sayin early
videos.description: Ohio State QB Julian Sayin goes back for a pass, but gets swarmed by Miami's defense for a sack.

videos.description: Ohio State's defense thwarts Miami in the red zone by forcing a fumble as the Buckeyes take over.
